impacts.description: Advances in model architecture, memory, reasoning, and autonomous behaviour are paving the way to unlocking AI agent potential across economic sectors, contributing to the Apply AI Strategy.
Contribution to the Apply AI Strategy through project results that advance next-generation AI agent research and deployment.
Results validated in Testing and Experiment Facilities and further deployed via European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs), contributing to broad societal uptake of AI agent technologies.

Significant improvements in AI agent autonomy, robustness and reliability through advanced planning, memory management, and reasoning — advancing the scientific state of the art in AI agent architectures.
Innovative multi-agent frameworks and protocols enabling decentralized coordination and collaboration, representing a technological advance beyond current individual-agent capabilities.
